title: Hextris
description: Rotate a hexagon and match falling colored blocks before the stack reaches the edge.
instructions: Click Play. Use the left and right arrows to rotate; match at least three blocks of one color. Touch either side on mobile.
authors: Logan Engstrom, Garrett Finucane, Noah Moroze, Michael Yang; Lite edition by Attogram
licenseNotes: Font Awesome font: OFL-1.1; CSS: MIT. Hammer, jQuery, js-cookie, JSONfn and SweetAlert: MIT. Keypress: Apache-2.0.
modifications: Fixed an upstream text-size concatenation bug (14220px instead of 142px) and use Arial as a local font fallback.
